kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_network_receive_packets_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_network_transmit_packets_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS Receive = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_network_receive_packets_total)), node_network_transmit_packets_total_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_network_transmit_packets_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL Transmit = (-1 * node_network_transmit_packets_total_B)
| DROP node_network_transmit_packets_total_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_softnet_processed_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_softnet_dropped_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS CPU_Processed = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_softnet_processed_total)), node_softnet_dropped_total_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_softnet_dropped_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.cpu
| EVAL CPU_Dropped = (-1 * node_softnet_dropped_total_B)
| DROP node_softnet_dropped_total_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_softnet_times_squeezed_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_softnet_times_squeezed_total = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_softnet_times_squeezed_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.cpu
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_network_up IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_network_carrier IS NOT NULL
| STATS operational_state_up = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.operstate == "up") and (metrics.node_network_up IS NOT NULL), metrics.node_network_up, NULL))), physical_link_state = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((metrics.node_network_carrier IS NOT NULL), metrics.node_network_carrier, NULL))) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND("Operational state UP", "Physical link state"), __values = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(operational_state_up), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(physical_link_state), ""))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL metric_label = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| EVAL series_group = CONCAT(COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.device`), ""), " / ", metric_label)
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC
